name: middag-io/wp-boilerplate
description: MIDDAG's reference architecture for a WordPress plugin — composes the OSS framework/wordpress/ui libraries end to end.

extra._comment:vendor-isolation: This OSS reference does NOT prefix its vendor tree. Prefixing Symfony DI alone is incoherent because middag-io/framework exposes Symfony DI types in its public API (BootstrapInterface::configure(ContainerBuilder)) and is not prefixed alongside it. A production plugin that must coexist with other plugins bundling a different framework/Symfony scopes the WHOLE graph (middag-io/framework + Symfony + PSR) with PHP-Scoper at build time — see README 'Vendor isolation'. That is a product-build concern (D6), deliberately not demonstrated here to keep the reference coherent.
